verdict.rationale: Penpot documents outbound webhooks that fire on events such as a file being created or updated or a comment being added, and it offers a plugin and API layer for workflow automation. This gives event-driven hooks, but the rules and actions have to be built in external apps or custom code; there is no evidence of a native way to define rules that trigger actions. Missing for 10: native rule/trigger builder, conditional logic, built-in action types, a documented list of webhook event types and configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.
